title: Overclaiming risk before approvals
body: The main comms risk is stating rate, eligibility or app availability before formal approvals are in Metis.

title: Positive product story needs caveats
body: The product story is positive but requires disciplined caveats — this is readiness, not a campaign.

title: Leadership needs readiness not a campaign plan
body: Executive audience needs a readiness view with dependencies and decisions — not marketing campaign detail.

title: Ops and accessibility are launch dependencies
body: Customer operations and accessibility wording should be treated as launch readiness dependencies, not afterthoughts.

title: Trade press may force holding line
body: Trade press interest may require a holding line before final go/no-go even when internal confidence is high.

title: Version compare should show approval changes
body: Executive brief comparison should highlight what changed after digital and pricing approvals.
